name: Fair Duelist Difficulty
summary: Configurable Fair Duelist balance: 25% less enemy health by default, Fair damage and stamina costs. Customize health, damage, stamina and enemy attack pressure through an INI. UE4SS required for INI settings.
author: oOCamilleOo

file.description: Fair Duelist preset with configurable health, damage and stamina multipliers and enemy attack pressure. Defaults: 75% enemy health, normal damage and stamina costs. UE4SS required for INI settings.

changelog: Initial Nexus release, combining the development changes.
Keep Duelist enemy health, aggression, action settings and hidden directional indicators.
Use Fair enemy damage and combat stamina costs.
Rename Duelist to Fair Duelist and correct preset, RPG and Action descriptions.
Support independent customization through the existing RPG and Action settings.
